title: HBG Renewals
purpose: What is being built for Homebody Guaranty renewals, whether it is what clients need, and when it ships. Transfers are tracked here too but are off the critical path.

tiles.label: Open bugs, HBG
tiles.source: Jira 2026-10-01 · project DEV · open bugs · excl. Auto-Triage · HB-Deposit Alternative

items.text: A renewal lease interval must exist for HBG to renew.
No month-to-month, including a roll to month-to-month because move-out has not been performed.
HBG auto-renewal does not copy Deposit Alternative auto-renewal.
Block list: a claim in Open or Closed Paid.
Block list: a duplicate policy on another lease before the renewal lease is created.
Insurance ops confirms the scenarios that should not renew.
Robert Jones and Dan Bullock lock final renewal requirements.
